decisions.note: Pinned skill 108101211 is Japanese 相手が誰でも関係ねーし！. The title is strongly character-voiced and several Vietnamese colloquial renderings are plausible; defer rather than canonize one register.
Pinned skill 203972 is なりふり構わず. 'Bất chấp tất cả' is a concise natural Vietnamese skill title matching the Japanese idiom's disregard-for-consequences sense.
Pinned skill 110601111 is Japanese 焦らず、気負わず. The Chinese bridge compresses two nuances; Vietnamese options differ between 'không vội/không gồng' and more formal phrasing, so defer canonical wording.
Pinned skill 110501111 is Japanese 銀河のその先へ、あなたと. It is a poetic character-specific title with several equally natural Vietnamese word orders; defer rather than lock a stylistic choice.
Pinned skill 202191 is Japanese 一意専心. The meaning is clear, but multiple Vietnamese title forms ('toàn tâm toàn ý', 'nhất tâm chuyên chú') are plausible and no project convention resolves them.
Pinned skill 200431 is Japanese コンセントレーション. A Vietnamese lock would need a project decision between translating the loanword and preserving a conventional skill-name form; defer.
Pinned skill 210352 is 時代を変える者. 'Người thay đổi thời đại' is a direct, natural Vietnamese title without unresolved proper-name or gameplay terminology issues.
Pinned skill 200033 is 東京レース場×. Use the verified racecourse name Tokyo and preserve the × grade marker exactly.
Pinned skill 200032 is 東京レース場○. Use the verified racecourse name Tokyo and preserve the ○ grade marker exactly.
Pinned skill 200031 is 東京レース場◎. Keep the same title family as the ○/× variants and preserve the ◎ grade marker exactly.
Pinned skill 111401111 is Japanese ふたりの約束、とどく時. The title is lyrical and 'とどく' allows several natural Vietnamese treatments; defer canonical wording.
Pinned skill 202832 is Japanese 二段構え. The title can denote a two-stage/two-pronged setup; the Chinese bridge is only one interpretation, so defer until a stable Vietnamese skill convention is chosen.
Pinned skill 203941 is まばたき厳禁！. 'Cấm chớp mắt!' is concise, natural and preserves the emphatic imperative title.

Pinned skill 102801111 is Japanese 下ごしらえ万全！, a food-preparation metaphor. The Chinese bridge shifts the image toward battle-readiness, so defer rather than canonize a translation from the Chinese wording.
